purpose: First real game-platform foundation for player profiles, save continuity, roster ownership, progression, inventory, economy ledger, and telemetry-ready platform events.

rules.identity: One player profile owns one canonical save state in the mock platform service.
rules.persistence: Every platform mutation returns a complete serializable state snapshot that can be stored and reloaded without loss.
rules.economy: Currency mutations must be represented as ledger entries; balances are derived from the ledger plus initial grants.
rules.roster: Titan ownership and active deity selection live in platform state, not browser-only UI state.
rules.progression: Mission completion, account XP, level, and unlocks must survive reload.
rules.serverPath: This mock service is local and deterministic. A future backend must preserve the same contract before replacing it.
